exercises.n: Chest press, Hammer Strength iso-lateral (kg per side)
exercises.note: Seat height setting 5. Ramped 25, 35, 45, then 40. Top set 45x4 clean plus 2 assisted. Working load is 40, not 25.
Personal best: +10 x 8, and this was the second exercise, not the first. Third set dropped to +5 on purpose to stay in the rep range.

exercises.n: Row machine, plate loaded (kg per side)
exercises.note: NOT the Nautilus vertical row from 5 Sep, which is a stack machine. Plate loaded, kg per side. First set at 40 had a shortened range of motion, dropped to 30 for full range, then 35 for 7 clean. Working load 35.

exercises.n: Seated shoulder press machine (kg per side)
exercises.note: Swapped in for the seated dumbbell press at his request. Monday was 25 x 9. Third set a planned back-off to 25 to land in the rep range.

Took 15 kg although 10 was prescribed, swung both sets and reported it himself, then swung 8 kg as well. Movement pattern problem, not a load problem. Seated lateral raise from next session, start 8 kg.

exercises.n: EZ bar curl (kg per side, plates)
exercises.note: Unit changed today: plate load per side, not total. The EZ bar is 5 to 8 kg, not the 10 assumed before. Hit the top of the range, 12.5 per side next time.
Rope, not the straight bar. He asked for this work after the coach cut it on a miscount. Last set to failure, the reps went ugly at the end.

name: Upper
notes: First session after the rest day. Chest press working load corrected from 25 to 40 per side. Best pull-up session so far, done second in the order. Shoulder press machine replaces the seated dumbbell press. Lateral raises swung at every load, seated variant from next session. The pushdown was cut by mistake and put back: the briefing counted every press as a full triceps set, the real weekly figure was 13.5 not 24.
